status: Implementation contract for fixed default roles; the application must enforce these grants and scope checks.

conventions.manage_permission: Read/create/update/activate/deactivate the named resource, subject to scope, lifecycle, and specific admin protections.
conventions.platform_scope: No implied org.* grant. Tenant processing/data requires an explicit active accepted organization membership.
conventions.organization_scope: Resolve current membership and optional department scope on the server. org_admin must have no department restriction.
conventions.device_scope: Resolve organization/device from the device credential. No human membership or platform role is available to a device.
conventions.trainee_media: Results and media are readable only within the trainee's assigned organization/department, with authorized temporary download URLs.
conventions.current_identity: Authenticate the current identity and resolve current assignments. Active status is required for business operations; inactive devices have only the explicit lifecycle exceptions below. Token role claims alone are insufficient.
conventions.identity_routes: Active authenticated humans may read their own identity/memberships and update permitted contact fields without an org role. Verified humans may accept a valid invitation; organization creation additionally requires self_service mode. These routes never accept role or identity-authority changes from caller input.
conventions.history_scope: Read historical records using their recorded organization/department context, not the device's new department.
conventions.mutations: Role, administrator, platform settings, and organization changes produce administrative audit events.
conventions.catalog_changes: Change through reviewed application releases, not platform-settings JSON or tenant APIs.

lifecycle_rules.last_platform_admin: Use the platform_settings singleton lock; never remove/deactivate the last active platform administrator.
lifecycle_rules.last_org_admin: Every active organization needs an accepted active org_admin whose global user is active.
lifecycle_rules.global_deactivation: Replace affected last organization administrators or suspend their organizations in the same transaction.
lifecycle_rules.inactive_device: Allow restricted configuration/status, health, and status/error events only; no capture, processing submission, result download, or playback.
lifecycle_rules.maintenance: Pause new enrollment/processing; preserve authorized reads, admin recovery, device health/status, and cleanup.
lifecycle_rules.onboarding: A verified active user may create an organization only in self_service mode and receives org_admin there, never platform_admin.
lifecycle_rules.bootstrap: Grant the first platform_admin via a trusted deployment operation against a verified identity; never via public signup.

roles.name: Platform Admin
roles.description: Manage organizations, global identities/administrators, platform configuration, administrative audit, and aggregate health.

roles.name: Org Admin
roles.description: Manage members and resources throughout the assigned organization, including processing and audit.

roles.name: Org User
roles.description: Read permitted operational data and run approved processing/playback in assigned scope.

roles.name: Org Read Only
roles.description: Read operational data and configuration summaries in assigned scope without starting work or changing records.

roles.name: Trainee
roles.description: Read device summaries, basic status, processing results, and media in assigned scope; no execution, detailed telemetry, configuration, or administrative access.

roles.name: Org Device
roles.description: Access only this authenticated device's configuration, work, results, telemetry, and playback acknowledgments.
